hosting.// site: switch-proj holds several Hosting sites. Naming ours pins the deploy to switch-ops.web.app — without it a plain `firebase deploy --only hosting` would publish this app over the project's default site. The site has to exist first: `firebase hosting:sites:create switch-ops`.
hosting.// cleanUrls: next build with output:'export' emits /orders.html, not /orders/index.html — cleanUrls is what serves it at /orders. Without it every in-app URL 404s.
hosting.// headers: Later entries win over earlier ones, so the catch-all comes first and the immutable rule for hashed assets overrides it. HTML must not be cached: without an explicit Cache-Control, Hosting defaults to an hour, and a deploy would take that long to reach anyone who had already loaded the app.
